user_decision: Deliver the competition software checkpoint in at most two substantive implementation batches before real cloud-model and HarmonyOS experiments. Advanced evolution and lifecycle accounting must not block the main repair path.
observed_implementation: The existing SDK repair loop supports source/log reading, diagnosis, candidate edits and frozen diffs, synthetic checks, feedback revision, bounded termination and resume.

Enabled repair working context changes actual solver input. Experience retrieval, premise review and complete static procedure reads are SDK tools; this proves software handoff rather than semantic effectiveness.
Obligations and repair-direction decisions are optional model-inferred guidance and linked records. They do not certify business semantics or automatically execute diagnostic probes.
Finite condition calculations use synthetic observations. Automatic source literal and runtime sampling are not implemented in the current SDK path.
Tracked resources/configs do not provide a formal competition domain Skill bundle; current loading scenarios use test fixture content in addition to built-in rule cards.
The current model adapter requires MockTransport; the managed repair entry remains offline-only, checks are offline_synthetic and reports retain application_verification=not_run.
The analysis snapshot is not a complete buildable application. Full-project binding and candidate patch mapping remain necessary for the local execution channel.
delivery_targets: Implement real cloud-request and guarded local build/test code channels, tested only with mock services and short synthetic programs during this phase.

Provide a unified CLI, explicit competition configuration and reviewable generic domain Skills; verify the main contribution's links across diagnosis, decisions, candidates and feedback within an offline end-to-end run.
deferred_not_completed: Model-derived Skill activation and downstream deployment/resume/export remain unaccepted after the recorded cumulative read-capacity failure.
Complete lifecycle ResearchProfile, cross-stage learning budgets and automatic runtime sampling remain incomplete. Their original evidence and constraints are retained.
changes: Aligned existing development overview, implementation plan, design scope and actual status; no product source, dependencies, resource limits, data or submission templates changed.

checks.semantic_review: Reviewed the changed scope, unchanged evidence boundaries and relevant design/contract/metric references. Original advanced-feature failures remain incomplete; ordinary task budget and application acceptance requirements remain in force.

boundary: This is a scope correction and implementation audit, not either of the two promised implementation batches or a claim that the competition software checkpoint has been achieved.
